description: Compute real (inflation-adjusted) purchasing power of a future amount. Use for retirement or savings goal in today's euros. Inputs: nominal future amount, years, average inflation %. Returns real value. See list_bundles for related 'finance-universal' calculators.

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").
